author_header.use_when: Who wrote something: an avatar beside a name and handle, above a post or a comment.

back_button.use_when: Back in a header you draw yourself; @core/page_header already has it.

button.use_when: Any button. Use it or core://Button; never a Tappable over a Box.

callout.use_when: A panel that says one thing in a tone: a tip, a warning, pros or cons, one section of a detail screen.

card.use_when: One thing in a bordered card: an event, a site, an alert. For several rows in one card use @core/grouped_card.

check_circle.use_when: The ring or ticked circle at the start of a row that says whether it is done, in a Tappable you wire yourself. For a whole row that ticks a field use @core/checkable_row.

checkable_row.use_when: A row that ticks a yes/no field of its item at a tap: a to-do, a grocery item, a lesson done.

chevron_card.use_when: A card that opens something, with a › at its end: a banner or a link to another screen.

choice_chip.use_when: One choice among several that a tap writes to a row's field or keeps as a draft: a kind, a time slot, a day.

collapsible.use_when: A section the user opens and closes (Older, Advanced).

counted_list.use_when: A list that shows its rows in a card, or one quiet line while it is empty, from a single count query.

date_block.use_when: A compact date leading a row: the weekday over the day of the month.

divided_item.use_when: A list item with a divider under it, on the page rather than in a card.

dot.use_when: A small coloured dot: unread, online, a legend or a status.

empty_state.use_when: A list or screen with nothing in it yet: an icon, a title, why it's empty or when it fills, and one action. Use it instead of a lone muted line.

eyebrow.use_when: A small label in capitals over a heading: what a sheet is about, a lesson's course, a card's kind.

filled_card.use_when: A filled card whose text takes one colour: an item's heading, a status at a glance.

footer_bar.use_when: A bar pinned under a page: a count or a hint, then the page's main button.

grouped_card.use_when: Several rows in one rounded card, as a settings group or a short list; the rows bring their dividers.

grouped_list.use_when: Rows in one rounded card with hairlines between them: a list, a menu, a settings group. The usual home of rows.

header_bar.use_when: A root page's header: a title on the left, icon buttons on the right, no Back.

icon_row.use_when: A row that leads with an icon: a title, one muted line, optional trailing text and a ›. The usual row of a menu or a list.

item_row.use_when: Any row with something at either end: a leading icon, checkbox or picture, a title and a muted line, a trailing tag or value, a ›.

labeled_text.use_when: One field of an item on its own screen (Description, Notes), hidden while empty.

link_button.use_when: A button that opens a web link, hidden while there is no link.

list_row.use_when: A plain row: a title and a quiet value at the end (a version, a count).

loading_spinner.use_when: A spinner while the screen's data loads, in a header you draw yourself. @core/page_header has one (loading), and @core/screen and @core/screen_scaffold draw their own.

message_page.use_when: A whole page that only says something: a welcome, an empty pod, an error with Try again.

muted_note.use_when: What a list says while it is empty, or a hint under a heading. Give it the list's count and it shows only while the list is empty.

muted_text.use_when: Any quiet text: a row's second line, a date, a caption. Use it instead of a Box that only sets the muted colour.

page_header.use_when: A pushed page's header: Back, the title, icon buttons on the right.

pill.use_when: A small tag with text: a status, a date, a count, a category.

pinned_bar.use_when: A search field or view chips pinned at the top while the page scrolls under them. Use it instead of a core://Sticky around a page-coloured Box.

screen.use_when: A screen with the app's old chrome: Back, title, spinner, error with Try again, scrolling content and a footer.

screen_scaffold.use_when: The usual root of a page or a screen: a header with Back, title and actions, scrolling content, and an optional bar pinned underneath.

scroll_page.use_when: A whole page: header with Back, a divider, then the children scrolling. The usual root of a page or a screen.

section_header.use_when: A section's heading on the page, optionally under a divider.

section_label.use_when: A quiet heading above a grouped card: a month, a settings group.

stat.use_when: A number with a label under it: a count tile, one cell of a row of figures.

tab_shell.use_when: The root of home once there are a few layouts: tabs as a dock on a phone and a rail on a wide window, each tab one embedded layout.

text_link.use_when: A quiet action in words: Clear beside a list, Edit in a header.

tinted_icon.use_when: An icon in a tinted circle: a row's leading icon, a category.

tinted_text.use_when: A text in one colour other than the muted one: an event's time in the accent, an error line, a heading in a section's hue. Use it instead of a Box that only sets content_color.

title_meta.use_when: A bold title over one muted line: a name and its details.

titled_section.use_when: A section of a page: a quiet heading with the space around it, over a card or a list.

toggle_action.use_when: An icon that flips a yes/no field at once and tells an endpoint: like, favourite, pin, bookmark.

two_pane.use_when: A list beside its detail on a wide window, the list alone on a phone.

warning_chip.use_when: A warning said in a few words.

workspace.use_when: A page as the app once drew a workspace: a headline title, the content scrolling under it.
